billing_model: Basic or Advanced Package + matching Additional Branch; Implementation per branch (one-time); add-ons (HR, Cost Center, Central Kitchen, B2B Invoicing and more). Quote rules: 1 Package (Basic / Advanced) + (branches − 1) Additional Branch of the SAME package. Implementation: 1 line per branch (one-time). Add-ons only on request.
payment_terms: Billing options in Salesforce: Annual, One-time.
discount_policy: Internal (do not share with merchants or partners): discounts on New Business only; none on Expansion, Renewal, Upgrade/Downgrade or Re-activation. Branch tiers: 1–2 branches → No discount (auto-rejected); 3–5 → Minimum of the range; 6–7 → 50% of the maximum; 8–14 → 75% of the maximum; 15–21 → 100% of the maximum; 22+ → Kareem decides. Ranges: Annual 4% – 10%; Monthly, Quarterly, Semi-annual 3% – 8%; One-time fees Never discounted. Approver: Kareem Ibrahim; escalation Hatem Ashour.
commercial_notes: Edge: Advanced adds assets, production (assembly), waste and payroll. Modular add-ons. Watch out: Additional Branch must match the package. Implementation is per branch. Prices are list (selling) prices per line per billing period. Source: Salesforce Standard Price Book, list prices, exported 5 Nov 2026.
